segments.name: Total Artificial Heart
segments.description: Manufactures and sells the only FDA-approved Total Artificial Heart, a bridge to heart transplantation for end-stage heart failure patients.
segments.evidence: The SynCardia TAH is powered by pneumatic drivers available for in-hospital use, the Companion 2 Driver ("C2 Driver"), and for in-home use, the Freedom Driver.

revenueModel.text: The company sells SynCardia TAH products with related services and earns rental revenue from the devices.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue from products includes related services, which represented less than 10 % of product revenue for both periods.

changes.text: In May 2025, the company began winding down its German sales subsidiary, SynCardia Systems Europe GmbH.
changes.evidence: In May 2025, the Company initiated an orderly wind down of GmbH.
